title_en: PGA drone spying on smugglers, four arrested at Kelantan-Thailand border
summary_en: TUMPAT: Four including a woman from neighboring country were arrested by the General Operations Group (PGA) after they were suspected of being involved in smuggling and illegal entry activities along the Kelantan-Thailand border following drone surveillance.
